description: A parenthesized call site with more arguments than a user procedure's total parameter count raises ol-too-many-inputs at the callee span, checked at runtime call time; shares the callable/expected/actual param shape with #111's static rule. Issue #97. Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why the runtime's copy does not appear beside the check's.
